item.title: FRESHPOINT CENTRAL FLORIDA, INC.: Cranberry Chicken Salad Wedge 4.5 oz package in Wedge plastic and clear container with a plastic film sealing the top. Recall
item.product: Cranberry Chicken Salad Wedge 4.5 oz package in Wedge plastic and clear container with a plastic film sealing the top.
item.summary: The chicken salad sandwich has an improperly declared allergen (egg). While egg is included in the ingredients list on the package label, it is not included in the allergen Contains statement. Product details: Cranberry Chicken Salad Wedge 4.5 oz package in Wedge plastic and clear container with a plastic film sealing the top.
item.payoutAmount: Refund, replacement, correction, or disposal if stated by the official notice
